name: What happens during a professional rain damage roof inspection?

mainEntity.name: What happens during a professional rain damage roof inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: During a rain damage roof inspection, a certified inspector will thoroughly examine your roof for signs of water intrusion, material degradation, and structural issues. This typically involves checking shingles, flashing, gutters, and downspouts for leaks, punctures, or displaced components. They will also inspect the attic for water stains, mold, or moisture. Our inspectors look for both obvious and subtle indicators of water damage, such as granules in gutters, soft spots on the decking, or compromised seals around vents and chimneys, providing a detailed report of their findings.
acceptedAnswer.description: A professional rain damage roof inspection involves a thorough examination of shingles, flashing, gutters, and the attic for water intrusion, material degradation, and structural issues, both visible and subtle.
